title: General
description: The URLs this instance is reached at, its license, and who can see resource activity.

url.label: Application URL
url.description: The URL users access Attraccess at (used for redirects, links, and API callbacks).

errors.invalid: Enter a full URL, including http:// or https://.

publicInternetUrl.label: Public Internet URL
publicInternetUrl.description: Optional URL used for external callbacks (e.g. SumUp).

errors.invalid: Enter a full URL, including http:// or https://.

licenseKey.label: License Key
licenseKey.description: Paste a new license key to update. Leave empty to keep the current one.

activityVisibility.label: Who can see resource activity
activityVisibility.description: Controls who sees which resources are in use and by whom. People always see their own sessions.
activityVisibility.introduced: Only people introduced to the resource
activityVisibility.introducedHint: Only people introduced to a resource (directly or through a group), its introducers and maintainers, and users with Update Resources or Manage Resource Access see its activity. On resources that allow or require supervised use, everyone else sees only Available or In Use, without a name.
activityVisibility.loadFailed: The resource activity setting could not be loaded.
